=== PAGE 1 ===
Spontaneous Regression of Metastatic Melanoma

Abstract
We report spontaneous complete regression in a patient with metastatic melanoma.

=== PAGE 2 ===
Case Presentation
A 67-year-old man was diagnosed with metastatic melanoma.
Two weeks before regression, a biopsy was performed.
No systemic therapy was administered before regression.
Complete regression was observed.
At 12 months, he remained free of recurrence.

=== PAGE 3 ===
Discussion
The authors suggest that biopsy-induced inflammation may have contributed to regression.
